scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @vpds/web --
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @vpds/web
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @vpds/backend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @vpds/backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:api
scripts.test:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @vpds/web && npm run test --workspace @vpds/ui-specification
scripts.test:api: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @vpds/backend && npm run test --workspace @vpds/evaluation
